parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that determines the start point of the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Only scaling groups are supported. Valid values: scalinggroup.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key used to perform an exact search for Elastic scaling resources. The tag key must be 1 to 128 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

Tag.N is used to perform an exact search for Elastic scaling resources that have the specified tag bound. Tag.N consists of a key-value pair.

- If you specify only Tag.N.Key, all resources that are associated with the tag key are returned.

- If you specify only Tag.N.Value, the MissingParameter.TagKey error is returned.

- If you specify multiple tag key-value pairs at the same time, only Elastic scaling resources that match all the specified tag key-value pairs are returned.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The label value used to perform an exact search for elastic scaling resources. The label value can be an empty string. Maximum length: 128 characters. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
